item.title: AWS Heroes Summit 2025 — A Week of Learning, Community, and Inspiration
item.description:
Back home after an incredible week of learning, networking, reconnecting with old friends, and making new ones in the community — truly an amazing experience!

Grateful to the AWS team and organizers — Taylor Jacobsen, Ross Barich, Farrah Campbell, Gunnar Grosch, Jason Dunn, Shafraz Rahim, Rashmi Nambiar, Vinicius Senger, Paxton L Hall, Corey Strausman and team — for curating a week filled with keynotes, breakouts, and Ask Me Anything sessions with the product teams. Learned so much from them.
